pubspec.yaml:
name: mj_card_tracker
description: "Keepsake: MJ Card Collector app."
publish_to: 'none'

version: 1.0.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ^3.12.0

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  firebase_core: ^3.6.0
  firebase_auth: ^5.3.1
  cloud_firestore: ^5.4.4
  firebase_storage: ^12.3.0
  image_picker: ^1.1.2

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^5.0.0
  flutter_launcher_icons: "^0.14.4"

flutter_launcher_icons:
  image_path: "assets/LOGOPNG.png"
  android: true
  ios: true

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

  assets:
    - assets/
